definitions.explanation: An informal, somewhat masculine word for lunch. Less polite than {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}.

examples.japanese: {昼飯|ひるめし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: What are you having for lunch?

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{昼飯|ひるめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{損|そこ}ねた→損ねる：12710_sokoneru⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy with work that I missed lunch.

notes:
An informal, somewhat rough word for lunch. Has a masculine tone and sounds blunt. Not appropriate in polite or formal situations.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (midday) + ⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧ (meal, informal).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧: lunch — standard, neutral
- ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧: lunch — formal, written
- ⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧: lunch — casual, modern

SAME REGISTER:
- ⟦{朝飯|あさめし}→朝飯：17356_asameshi⟧: breakfast (informal)
- ⟦{晩飯|ばんめし}→晩飯：19760_banmeshi⟧: dinner (informal)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昼飯|ひるめし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have lunch
- {昼飯|ひるめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to eat lunch (very casual, uses ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ instead of ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
